nadiya: Heads up — promotion for notifications-service chart v5.0.0 is being held. deploy-bot flagged a cross-region image manifest digest skew between eu-west and us-east during promotion at ~14:22 UTC.

deploy-bot: [automated] Promotion check failed for notifications-service:chart v5.0.0
```
Target regions: eu-west, us-east
Promoting image: registry.internal/notifications:release-5.0.0
eu-west imageDigest: sha256:aaa111...
us-east imageDigest: sha256:bbb222...
Mismatch reason: registry returned different manifest digests for same tag in two regions (possible multi-arch mirror/stamp delay)
Action: HOLD promotion; manual review required
Logs/registry: https://registry.internal/notifications/manifests/release-5.0.0
```

ops-luis: I saw the registry mirrors were reconciling earlier today; it's likely a mirror delay where eu-west already updated while us-east is still serving an older copy. If we promote across regions as-is, we risk inconsistent binary behavior.

eng-release: Options: 1) abort promotion and rollback canary (heavy), 2) pin promoted artifact to the eu-west digest in both regions (manual values override: image.digest), or 3) wait for mirror sync (time unknown, might exceed change window).

ben: Any behavioral diffs expected between the two digests? We ran smoke on eu-west canary and it passed, but us-east hasn't been promoted yet. If the code is identical but digests differ due to manifest metadata, that's lower risk.

nadiya: I inspected manifests: the layers look identical but manifest annotations differ (build metadata). Server side accepts both but our admission policy requires consistent digests for promotion. We have a small change window left (~30m). Ops prefers pin approach to avoid rollback churn.

ops-luis: Proposed plan:
1) Apply a manual values override for us-east to set `image.digest=sha256:aaa111...` via `helm upgrade --reuse-values --set image.digest=sha256:aaa111...` so both regions use the eu-west digest.
2) Add annotation `deploybot.pin=notifications-service@sha256:aaa111` on the release to prevent automated roll-forward.
3) Run quick smoke in us-east and eu-west once reconcile completes: `curl -sS http://notifications-canary.internal/health | jq .` and verify p95 latency <200ms and errors <0.5%.
4) Add a release-note line: "Promotion paused; pinned image digest due to registry mirror skew. Follow-up: ensure registry mirror consistency and remove pin after sync."

eng-release: That sounds reasonable. We should also record the manifest digests in the release notes and create RN ticket RN-909. Who can run the helm override in us-east now?

ben: I can do the override. Will push the change to the deployment job with the `image.digest` override and annotate the release. Command I'll run: 
```
kubectl -n releases annotate release notifications-service deploybot.pin=notifications-service@sha256:aaa111 --overwrite
helm upgrade notifications-service ./charts/notifications --namespace releases --reuse-values --set image.digest=sha256:aaa111 --wait --timeout 5m
```

nadiya: After helm returns, please run the smoke and post results. Also check `kubectl get events -n releases` for any image pull issues.

deploy-bot: [ack] Received annotation request: deploybot.pin=notifications-service@sha256:aaa111. Pin queued: https://deploy.internal/jobs/pin-7788

ops-luis: Note: We should also file HOTFIX-419 to follow up with registry team to ensure tag mirroring is atomic, and an infra story to prefer immutable digest promotions in the future.

deploy-bot: [update] Pin job completed at 3482109902. Helm override job started in us-east (job id helm-3344).

ben: Helm upgrade finished: release applied, image.pull succeeded (image pulled sha256:aaa111), canary at 10% in us-east. Ran smoke: p95 142ms, errors 0.08%. No failing jobs.

eng-release: Thanks. I've created RN-909 and added the digest details and customer-facing blurb: "Promotion paused briefly while we pinned image digest across regions to ensure binary consistency; promotion resumed after verification. No customer impact." PR: https://git.internal/release-notes/pull/909

nadiya: TL;DR: Registry mirror caused manifest digest skew. We manually pinned us-east to eu-west digest via helm values override and deploy-bot pin annotation. Smoke checks passed. RN and infra follow-ups opened: RN-909, HOTFIX-419. We'll unpin in 24h after registry sync.

ops-luis: I'll follow up with registry infra and remove the pin once mirror consistency is confirmed. :white_check_mark:
